Team Decaf Tuesday Ride

Pittsburgh, PA · Highland Park · Road

Team Decaf Tuesday Ride is a road group ride in Pittsburgh, PA. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Highland Park entrance (welcome sculptures), top of N Highland Ave at Reservoir Dr. About 17 miles, slower and faster groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slower and faster groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Team Decaf Tuesday Ride group ride

City road rides out of Highland Park, splitting into slower and faster groups. Around thirty riders a week. Lights recommended early and late in the season.
